## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: mixed sector signals (only Communication, Energy, Utilities, REITs positive) and MAJOR divergence among large caps (AAPL, MSFT, NVDA, JPM, TSLA showing 1W ≠ 1M), Leadership: Broad (Top 5 span 4 sectors).

2. Which sectors are leading?  
Communication lead: CMCSA (1W: +1.74% | 1M: +12.45%) ABOVE TREND, CHTR (1W: +1.69% | 1M: +6.00%) ABOVE TREND, TMUS (1W: +2.72% | 1M: -1.74%) RECOVERY. Energy strong: XOM (1W: +0.77% | 1M: +3.18%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +1.26% | 1M: -0.09%) RECOVERY, OXY (1W: +2.54% | 1M: -2.32%) RECOVERY. Consumer Discretionary showing pockets of strength: NKE (1W: +11.11% | 1M: -2.57%) RECOVERY, TGT (1W: +3.66% | 1M: +6.99%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?  
Technology lagging: AAPL (1W: -0.18% | 1M: -3.97%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -0.66% | 1M: -0.64%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -1.43% | 1M: +3.66%) CORRECTION. Financials weak: C (1W: -2.27% | 1M: +13.64%) CORRECTION, GS (1W: -2.52% | 1M: +8.94%) CORRECTION, JPM (1W: -1.14% | 1M: +4.31%) CORRECTION. Industrials soft: CAT (1W: -1.64% | 1M: +0.85%) CORRECTION, GE (1W: -2.27% | 1M: +6.91%) CORRECTION.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?  
Top 5: NKE (1W: +11.11% | 1M: -2.57%) RECOVERY; TGT (1W: +3.66% | 1M: +6.99%) ABOVE TREND; TMUS (1W: +2.72% | 1M: -1.74%) RECOVERY; OXY (1W: +2.54% | 1M: -2.32%) RECOVERY; KHC (1W: +2.32% | 1M: -4.41%) RECOVERY. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?  
Bottom 5: C (1W: -2.27% | 1M: +13.64%) CORRECTION; GE (1W: -2.27% | 1M: +6.91%) CORRECTION; MET (1W: -2.43% | 1M: +3.45%) CORRECTION; IBM (1W: -2.49% | 1M: -3.09%) BELOW TREND; GS (1W: -2.52% | 1M: +8.94%) CORRECTION. Weakness concentrated in Financials and Industrials — Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Financials).

6. Momentum Stocks?  
Strongest 1W movers: NKE (1W: +11.11%), TGT (1W: +3.66%), TMUS (1W: +2.72%), OXY (1W: +2.54%), DOW (1W: +2.10%). Note MAJOR divergence: multiple mega-caps (AAPL, MSFT, NVDA, JPM, TSLA) show 1W ≠ 1M — tactical volatility, watch for trend break.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?  
Mixed to weak; key names BELOW TREND or in CORRECTION: AAPL (1W: -0.18% | 1M: -3.97%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -0.66% | 1M: -0.64%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -1.43% | 1M: +3.66%) CORRECTION. Sector 1W: -0.85% and showing internal rotation; watch for leadership divergence between large-cap AI names and the rest.

8. Financials Outlook?  
Patchy with breadth downside; large banks in CORRECTION: C (1W: -2.27% | 1M: +13.64%) CORRECTION, GS (1W: -2.52% | 1M: +8.94%) CORRECTION, JPM (1W: -1.14% | 1M: +4.31%) CORRECTION. Sector 1W: -1.61% — signs of trend fatigue despite solid 1M gains.

9. Healthcare Outlook?  
Relatively steady: JNJ (1W: +0.57% | 1M: +0.78%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +1.63% | 1M: +2.82%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +0.28% | 1M: +1.59%) ABOVE TREND; sector 1W: -0.20% but pockets of defensive strength persist.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?  
Favor exposure to pockets of cyclicals and select Communication and Energy names (CMCSA, XOM, TGT) while reducing exposure to large-cap tech showing 1W weakness (AAPL, MSFT, NVDA) and Financials exhibiting trend exhaustion; style mixed / no clear leadership given divergence.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: CMCSA (1W: +1.74% | 1M: +12.45%) ABOVE TREND; TGT (1W: +3.66% | 1M: +6.99%) ABOVE TREND; XOM (1W: +0.77% | 1M: +3.18%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: AAPL (1W: -0.18% | 1M: -3.97%) BELOW TREND; TSLA (1W: -7.38% | 1M: +4.55%) CORRECTION; C (1W: -2.27% | 1M: +13.64%) CORRECTION.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: Communication (1W: +1.50%) and Energy (1W: +0.71%) — monitor follow-through and breadth within these sectors.  
BEARISH: Technology and Financials — both showing 1W weakness and trend-exhaustion signals among leaders.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?  
CMCSA above-trend follow-through: monitor for continued move above recent 1M gains (1W: +1.74% | 1M: +12.45%) to confirm leadership. NVDA resistance test as CORRECTION: watch 1W weakness vs 1M strength (1W: -1.43% | 1M: +3.66%) for trend break. AAPL support test as BELOW TREND (1W: -0.18% | 1M: -3.97%) — keep on watch for further downside.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?  
GE (+55): Industrial catalyst (excellent results) with GE (1W: -2.27% | 1M: +6.91%) CORRECTION — news confirmed but 1W pullback signals profit-taking.  
BA (+50): Contract win with BA (1W: +0.12% | 1M: +16.44%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirms strong 1M leadership.  
MA (+50): Positive payments pilot; MA (1W: -0.95% | 1M: +4.95%) CORRECTION — bullish news but short-term pullback, watch for re-accumulation.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?  
AAPL (-50): Berkshire selling headline with AAPL (1W: -0.18% | 1M: -3.97%) BELOW TREND — sentiment and price aligned, distribution risk.  
META (-50): Legal headline with META (1W: -0.73% | 1M: +3.08%) CORRECTION — negative news amid 1M strength, monitor for follow-through.  
C (-45): Russia-exit hit and C (1W: -2.27% | 1M: +13.64%) CORRECTION — headline consistent with 1W weakness despite strong 1M.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with style mixed / no clear leadership.  
Communication and Energy names showing relative strength (CMCSA ABOVE TREND, XOM ABOVE TREND, TGT ABOVE TREND).  
Key risk: MAJOR divergence across mega-caps (AAPL, MSFT, NVDA, JPM, TSLA) and sentiment-price mismatches (AAPL/META) — watch for trend confirmation before adding exposure.
